item.title: Globe, PLDT, and Converge Propose Nationwide Undersea Fiber Network
item.summary: Globe Telecom, Inc., PLDT Inc., and Converge ICT Solutions, Inc. have put forward a proposal for a USD 500 million (around PHP 30.63 billion) undersea fiber-optic network to improve connectivity across the Philippines, as stated by the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). Latest Read: ITU’s Dr. Cosmas Luckyson Zavazava on Connecting the Remaining […] The post Globe, PLDT, and Converge Propose Nationwide Undersea Fiber Network appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
